tasks.title: Announcement #35
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Man: Just a quick heads up before you all leave. Remember the next International Club film screening will be this Saturday at the Campus Theater. In the past, these screenings were for extra credit, but this semester they are a required part of our course to increase the number of participating students. After watching, you'll need to write a brief reflection on the film's cultural perspectives. This will be due next week. For more details on the assignment, please check our class website.

questions.stem: What is implied about screenings during past semesters?

options.D: Not enough students went to them.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：关于过去学期的放映活动暗示了什么？属于推断题。 定位原文：Man: In the past, these screenings were for extra credit, but this semester they are a required part of our course to increase the number of participating students. 选项分析： A. They were held off-campus. 它们在校外举行。因为通知未提及地点的变化，所以 A 选项错误。 B. Attendance was mandatory. 出席是强制性的。因为通知说过去是额外加分（暗示非强制），现在才是必修部分，所以 B 选项错误。 C. They were held every month. 它们每个月举行一次。因为通知未提及过去的举办频率，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Not enough students went to them. 去的学生不够多。由于男士提到改为必修是为了增加参与学生的数量，这暗示了过去参与人数不足，所以 D 选项正确。

questions.stem: What is required after attending the film screening?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：参加完电影放映后需要做什么？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Man: After watching, you'll need to write a brief reflection on the film's cultural perspectives. 选项分析： A. Writing a brief paper 写一篇短文。因为男士要求写一份简短的反思，这属于写短文的范畴，所以 A 选项正确。 B. Submitting a film review 提交影评。因为作业要求是写关于文化视角的反思，而不是常规的电影评论，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Researching a cultural topic 研究一个文化课题。因为作业是基于电影写反思，而不是独立进行研究，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Presenting a class project 展示一个课堂项目。因为通知只提到写作任务，未提及展示项目，所以 D 选项错误。
